rows.name: Duration
rows.note: limit 3:00 (180 s); aim <= 2:55 so a player rounding cannot exceed it

rows.name: File size
rows.note: limit 500 MB; <= 350 MB keeps uploads comfortable

rows.name: Audio
rows.note: form wants voice-over OR subtitles; here music + burned-in subtitles

rows.name: Frozen picture (>3 s)
rows.note: holds >3 s are expected only on the end card; anything else = stuck recording

rows.name: Watermark / overlays
rows.note: open the contact sheet: no browser chrome, no Playwright/Tabbit tray, no recorder logos, no third-party marks. Our pipeline adds none.

rows.name: Music provenance
rows.note: music/*/LICENCE-PROOF.md present for the chosen track (or original generated score); no commercial recording, no lyrics.

rows.name: Subtitles legible
rows.note: play at 100 % on a phone-size window: every caption readable, none over a control that matters, none cut off.

rows.name: Disclosure
rows.note: "示例角色、场次与照片均为虚构（AI 生成）" visible; no claim of real-phone/real-audience validation; AI described as on-device viewpoint suggestion only.
